searchText: has anyone thought about changes to the HTTP standard that would come under HF 1? on that front, are we ready for a release of the http standard? we will likely want to add some ability to support new sync committee duties for validators yeah, agreed. probably worth cutting a release soon and iterating for hf1 unless i hear otherwise, i'll make a note to intro a PR for the new API it would also be nice to cut a release soon, esp if we want to keep phase 0 / HF 1 / ... symmetry I'm assuming the API will have to support both pre and post fork data since you might be requesting a block or state from prior to the HF. i don't think that changes anything right? Still makes sense to cut a release at this point I think, but I don't think we can just have v2 be specified in terms of the new HF data structures. I don't think it's a big issue, just that the JSON schema for returned objects needs to explicitly support both formats (ie it's going to wind up with some optional elements) we could more strictly version v1, v2 ,etc and have "tight" types then it is on the caller to know which endpoint to call though Yeah that's what I think we can't do without it becoming a massive pain for users of the API.
